title: The Cloud Where Falling Hasn't Finished

features.name: suspended-drop
features.desc-on-touch: A water molecule held between cloud and ground, unable to decide. Falling and not-falling. The archive is reading its indecision as data.

features.name: altitude-register
features.desc-on-touch: Numbers in ascending order, height markers where rain pauses at different elevations. The cloud remembers each altitude it passed, refuses to forget any of them.

features.name: rain-memory-archive
features.desc-on-touch: A collection of trajectories mapped in the air—each droplet's intended path, recorded before it started falling. Some paths are never completed.

features.name: incompletion-monument
features.desc-on-touch: Built to celebrate the moment before something happens. The cloud itself is this monument—holding potential without delivering it.

features.name: time-between-breaths
features.desc-on-touch: A space marked only by waiting. Not dark, not bright. The air here is thick with words never said, weather never completed.

inscription: the falling that never arrives teaches more than the falling that does

file.name: Precipitation_Delay_Analysis_Fractional_Seconds_to_Impact.txt
file.note: measurement of the gap between sky and ground. The cloud marks each hesitation. Between raindrop and earth: an archive's worth of unreleased time. Status: still falling.

exits.label: down to the stone that learned to stop receiving
up into the cloud-heart where rain is still deciding
toward the wind that might change the fall direction
